methodology_boundary: This is an E001 application layer over canonical P023. It does not invent a second automaton-minimization theorem, interpolate unmeasured edges, identify predictive class count with physical degrees of freedom, or identify a finite measured polyline coordinate with an unknown continuum integral.

results.statement: A finite measured material protocol with one declared action alphabet compiles to a total finite action machine by routing every unmeasured successor to an explicit absorbing UNDERRESOLVED state, after which P023 supplies the stable future partition.
results.rationale: Measured successor information is preserved without interpolation, wraparound or invented cross-branch transitions.
evidence: implementation and regression blobs are byte-identical source to canonical main

results.statement: Completing previously unmeasured protocol edges is not monotone in predictive class count: added measurements may split classes, merge classes, or split and merge different history pairs in one completion.
source_evidence: protocol completion classifier and AFTER_REFINES/AFTER_COARSENS/INCOMPARABLE regressions
results.rationale: This prevents 'more measurement means only refinement' from becoming a universal predictive-state law.

results.statement: For each measured start state, the shortest action word reaching UNDERRESOLVED is an exact finite measurement-horizon witness; no such word identifies the action-closed measured region, independently of predictive equivalence.
results.rationale: Measurement closure and future-state quotienting answer different questions and remain separate diagnostics.
evidence: coverage implementation/test blobs are byte-identical source to canonical main

results.statement: Strictly monotone measured stress-strain branches admit exact finite trapezoid coordinates on declared integer axes; interior loading/returning grids may differ, while closed hysteresis comparison requires matching deformation endpoints and an explicit response-sign convention.

results.rationale: The computation is exact for the declared finite measured polyline and performs no interpolation of missing observations.
